name: Gardien des vivres
description: Heavy adult with large rounded torso, grey-olive mottled skin, short ridged crown, dark dreadlocks down upper back; bronze upper-face half-mask leaves large mandibles visible. Wide sand-coloured padded long vest, broad leather belt, elbow guards. Carries a broad shallow sealed ration chest against one side, two food bags secured to compact back frame. Weight shifted opposite load, calm stance.
